Posebna agenta tajne službe morata ustaviti zloglasnega medgalaktičnega terorista, preden bi ta uničil človeštvo.

Možje v črnem so skrivna vladna organizacija, ki je zadolžena za nadzorovanje in razreševanje vesoljskih aktivnosti na Zemlji. Agent Kay pod okrilje vzame novega rekruta Jaya, s katerim se znajdeta sredi smrtonosne zarote, izpod rok intergalaktičnega terorista. Dvojec dobi prvo skupno nalogo - zlobnemu vesoljcu prepečiti namero, ki bi lahko uničila svet.
men in black_1997.opis_omdb: Based off of the comic book. Unbeknownst to other people, there is a private agency code named MiB. This agency is some kind of extra terrestrial surveillance corporation. Then, one of the agency's finest men only going by the name "K" (Tommy Lee Jones) , is recruiting for a new addition to the agency. He has chosen James Edwards (Will Smith) of the N.Y.P.D. Then, one day, a flying saucer crashes into Earth. This was an alien a part of the "Bug" race. He takes the body of a farmer (Vincent D'Onofrio) and heads to New York. He is searching for a super energy source called "The Galaxy". Now, Agents J and K must stop the bug before it can escape with the galaxy.
men in black_1997.opis_sl_tmdb: Možje v črnem so od nekdaj varovali Zemljo pred sovražniki iz vesolja. Toda v najnovejši pustolovščini je izziv veliko večji: sovražnik se tokrat skriva med njimi samimi in znotraj tajne organizacije MIB.
men in black_1997.opis_en_tmdb: After a police chase with an otherworldly being, a New York City cop is recruited as an agent in a top-secret organization established to monitor and police alien activity on Earth: the Men in Black. Agent K and new recruit Agent J find themselves in the middle of a deadly plot by an intergalactic terrorist who has arrived on Earth to assassinate two ambassadors from opposing galaxies.

Marince, ki raziskujejo težave v bazi na Marsu, napadejo grozljivo mutirana bitja.

Odprava vesoljskih marincev preiskuje nenavadne dogodke na raziskovalni ustanovi na Marsu, vendar se zdi, da so prepuščeni na milost in nemilost genetsko izpopolnjenim ubijalskim strojem.
doom_2005.opis_omdb: Something has gone wrong at a remote scientific research station on Mars. All research has ceased. Communication has failed. And the messages that do get through are less than comforting. It's a level 5 quarantine and the only souls allowed in or out are the Rapid Response Tactical Squad - hardened Marines armed to the teeth with enough firepower to neutralize the enemy...or so they think.

doom_2005.opis_en_tmdb: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge, is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. Dr. Grimm, who is related to team member Reaper, informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

Boksar Alain Lefevre mora po naročilu gangsterja izgubiti pomemben dvoboj. Ker se temu upre in zmaga, se znajde v nevarnosti. Zbežati namerava v Ameriko, vendar nazadnje pristane v francoski tujski legiji v Afriki, kjer se mora spet boriti za preživetje.
legionnaire_1998.opis_omdb: Alain Lefevre is a boxer paid by a Marseille mobster to take a dive. When he wins the fight he attempts to flee to America with the mobster's girlfriend Katrina. This plan fails and he seeks escape by joining the foreign legion. As part of the legion he tangles with abusive lieutenant Steinkampf and bonds with legionnaires Luther, Mackintosh and Rosetti. The mobster discovers his whereabouts and enrolls two hit men to finish him off. With their fort under siege and enemies within, Lefevre finds that second chances are difficult to come by in the Legion.

Nekdanji gasilec se spopade s skupino teroristov, ki so ugrabili podpredsednika in druge talce med sedmo tekmo finala Stanleyjevega pokala lige NHL.

V nabito polni dvorani v Pittsburghu se odvija napeta hokejska tekma. Med gledalci je tudi ameriški podpredsednik in nihče ne sluti, da se bo veselje že čez nekaj trenutkov spremenilo v pravo grozo, saj jim skupina teroristov pripravlja neprijetno presenečenje.

Teroristi zajamejo talce, med katerimi je tudi Emily, hčerka gasilca Darrena McCorda. Darren se seveda takoj poda v reševalno akcijo in se zaplete v smrtonosno igro z vodjo teroristov.
sudden death_1995.opis_omdb: Darren McCord takes his two kids to a Pittsburgh Penguins National Hockey League play-off game, unknowing that the sports arena has been taken over by terrorists, who are holding the Vice President of the United States, as well as many other high-ranking officials hostage. Darren later becomes the only one who is aware of the situation. And, the stakes are raised when the terrorists announce that they will blow-up the building at the end of the game. Therefore, Darren must not only subdue the terrorists, but postpone the game and send it to overtime.
sudden death_1995.opis_sl_tmdb:

V nabito polni dvorani v Pittsburghu se odvija napeta hokejska tekma. Med gledalci je tudi ameriški podpredsednik in nihče ne sluti, da se bo veselje že čez nekaj trenutkov spremenilo v pravo grozo, saj jim skupina teroristov pripravlja neprijetno presenečenje.

Teroristi zajamejo talce, med katerimi je tudi Emily, hčerka gasilca Darrena McCorda. Darren se seveda takoj poda v reševalno akcijo in se zaplete v smrtonosno igro z vodjo teroristov.
sudden death_1995.opis_en_tmdb: When a man's daughter is suddenly taken during a championship hockey game – with the captors demanding a billion dollars by game's end – he frantically sets a plan in motion to rescue her and abort an impending explosion before the final buzzer.

hibernatus_1969.opis_neo:
Bogat poslovnež naleti na čudno težavo - dedka njegove žene so oživili s pomočjo znanosti. Ne zaveda pa se, da je minilo veliko desetletij.

Med odkopavanjem na Arktiki francoska skupina najde zamrznjeno truplo moškega. Zdi se, da moški ni imel več kot 25 let. Ker je truplo popolnoma ohranjeno, na inštitutu moškega uspejo oživeti.
hibernatus_1969.opis_omdb: The frozen body of Paul Fournier is discovered in Greenland where he had disappeared during a scientific expedition in 1905. Perfectly conserved he is brought back to life in the 1960s. His descendants take care of him: to spare him the cultural shock they behave so to make believe it's 1905 and they are his cousins, uncle...

hibernatus_1969.opis_en_tmdb: Hubert de Tartas' life becomes a complete muddle when his wife's grandfather is unearthed after having spent 65 years in frozen hibernation in the polar circle. After being de-frosted, the Hibernating Man believes it is still the beginning of the century. Nothing is spared to keep that illusion alive. At the end of his rope, Hubert blurts out the truth and takes the man from Edwardian times on a crazy spree through an ultramodern Twentieth Century.

Gwen je ravno odkrila, da je zadnja članica tajnega Kroga dvanajstih, ki potuje skozi čas. Zdaj mora nekako najti ravnovesje med nenehnimi potovanji v preteklost in vzdrževanjem odnosa z Gideonom, poleg tega pa poskuša odkriti temne skrivnosti, ki obkrožajo Krog.

cliffhanger_1993.opis_neo:
Ko se rop v zraku ponesreči, različne skupine po Skalnem gorovju iščejo kovčke, polne denarja.

Ko gre ena od njegovih reševalnih akcij po zlu in umre dekle njegovega najboljšega prijatelja, Gabe za nesrečo krivi sebe, zato službo obesi na klin in zapusti domače mesto. 

Nekaj mesecev kasneje se vrne, da bi prepričal svoje dekle Jessie, naj se mu pridruži v drugem kraju in si tam skupaj z njim ustvari novo življenje. 

Med njegovim obiskom pa reševalci prejmejo klic na pomoč in Gabe se še zadnjič pridruži kolegom, da bi rešili skupino nemočnih ljudi. Nihče pa ne ve, da gre v resnici za nevarne ugrabitelje.

Almost a year later, Gabe is asked to go back to the same mountain range and rescue a group of 'stranded' people. The only catch is that these so called 'stranded' people are in fact looking for three boxes filled with $100,000,000 and they need a mountain ranger to lead them to them!!

underworld awakening_2012.opis_neo:
Ko ljudje odkrijejo obstoj vampirjev in likanov, se začne vojna za iztrebljenje obeh vrst. Vampirska bojevnica Selene vodi boj proti človeštvu.

Vampirka Selene pobegne iz ujetništva, v katerem so jo zadrževali 12 let. V tem času so ljudje izvedeli za obstoj nesmrtnih bitij in skoraj iztrebili vse vampirje in volkodlake. Selene želi združiti razkropljene vampirske klane, ki bi ji pomagali pri uporu, toda svoj pohod na oblast načrtujejo tudi volkodlaki, zato se vname vsesplošna vojna.
underworld awakening_2012.opis_omdb: Mankind discover the existence of the Vampire and Lycan species and begin a war to annihilate the races. When Selene meets with Michael, they're hit by a grenade. 12 years later, Selene awakens and meets the vampire, David. She learns she had been the subject of scientist Dr. Jacob Lane, and the Vampire and Lycan species have been practically eradicated from Earth. Now, Selene and David must protect a 12-year-old girl against the Lycans who intend to use her.

smaragdgrün_2016.opis_neo:
Adaptacija zadnjega dela slavne trilogije o potovanju skozi čas.

Gwendolynino srce je zlomljeno, bo spet kdaj zaupala Gideonu? A časa za pretakanje solz ni. Zgodi se nekaj neverjetnega in Gwendolyn se mora podvizati.
smaragdgrün_2016.opis_omdb: After the events of Sapphire Blue, Gwen is heartbroken and confused about who she is and what the real powers of the Raven are. Not knowing who they can trust anymore, Gwen and Leslie try to figure out what nefarious plots the Count has up his sleeve with help from a sassy gargoyle. Using her personal chronograph, Gwen attempts to discover the tightly-knit secrets the Lodge has been keeping. Will Gwen be able to turn to Gideon in her time of need, or is her mistrust in him justified enough to separate them forever?

la folie des grandeurs_1971.opis_neo:
V Španiji v 17. stoletju finančni minister skuša očrniti kraljico z nadvse zapletenim načrtom.

Don Salluste zlorabi funkcijo ministra za finance in se gmotno okoristi. Kraljici, ki ministra prezira, uspe doseči, da ga preženejo z dvora. Užaljeni Don Salluste poskusi kraljico osramotiti, zato si izmisli zapleteno maščevanje. A doseže le to, da se v njegovega služabnika Blaza, ki naj bi zapeljal kraljico, zaljubi grda kraljičina spremljevalka.
la folie des grandeurs_1971.opis_omdb: Don Salluste, a petty tyrant in his own home and minister of the King of Spain, falls from grace. Wanting revenge, he tries to compromize the Queen with his valet Blaze, introduced as his cousin. But poor Blaze gets stuck with a rather repulsive duenna, who is madly in love with him and very keen on getting her way. This wild comedy takes off at a dashing pace set by the De Funes, Montand and Sapritch trio.

the legend of zorro_2005.opis_neo:
Čeprav se izogibata pustolovstvu, morata Don Alejandro de la Vega in njegova žena Elena ukrepati, ko je ogrožena pridružitev Kalifornije Uniji.

Zamaskirani junak se poda na najnevarnejšo misijo v svojem življenju.
the legend of zorro_2005.opis_omdb: In 1850--against the backdrop of political unrest, as the scheming Jacob McGivens tries to stop California from joining the Union--the mysterious black-caped masked swordsman, Alejandro de la Vega, aka Zorro, finds himself in an unavoidable predicament. Having spent almost a decade protecting his people and fighting injustice, Alejandro's wife, Elena, insists that he gives up the black mask, and become a true father to their eight-year-old son, Joaquin. However, when Elena leaves him for the French count, Armand, it becomes evident that the conceited aristocrat is up to no good. Can Zorro, the legendary defender of the innocent, save both his marriage and the country?

the legend of zorro_2005.opis_en_tmdb: Despite trying to keep his swashbuckling to a minimum, a threat to California's pending statehood causes the adventure-loving Don Alejandro de la Vega and his wife, Elena, to take action.

hitch_2005.opis_neo:
Prepričljiv mož se zaljubi v izkušeno kolumnistko, medtem pa plahemu računovodji pomaga zapeljevati lepo dedinjo.

Hitch je ljubezenski terapevt, čigar posebnost je, da pomaga 'manj srečnim' pri iskanju partnerja. A njegove veščine mu ne pomagajo pri lastnem ljubezenskem življenju. Ko poskuša osvojiti Saro, se mora tudi sam soočiti s težavami, ki jih je poprej jemal tako zlahka.
hitch_2005.opis_omdb: Pivoting around the eternal game of love, the suave matchmaker and New York City's finest date-doctor, Alex "Hitch" Hitchens, can guarantee that any man can get the girl of his dreams if he overcomes his fears and follows his infallible advice. However, when the timid accountant, Albert Brennaman, enlists his help to catch the attention of the rich and beautiful heiress, Allegra Cole, Hitch will unexpectedly discover his perfect match: the inquisitive gossip columnist, Sara Melas. Now, the self-assured charmer finds himself in need of his services to save his relationship. But, can the silver-tongued expert of romance survive the delicate complications of love?
hitch_2005.opis_sl_tmdb: Alex ‘Hitch’ Hitchens je samski moški, ki razume ženske in pozna umetnost zapeljevanja. Je mojster na področju ljubezni in ‘zdravnik za zmenke’. Je samozavestni frajer, ki za primeren honorar plašnim moškim pomaga spoznati in osvojiti ženske njihovih sanj. Trenutno trenira plahega, nerodnega in malce debelušnega računovodjo Alberta, ki je zatreskan v prelepo slavno bogatašinjo Allegro Cole. Ga bo Allegra, v katero je nesmrtno zaljubljen, sploh kdaj opazila? Hitch medtem spozna novinarko Saro, ki že ob prvem srečanju pritegne njegovo pozornost. In kar naenkrat ga preplavijo čustva, ki se jim je do sedaj zaradi srčne rane izpred let izogibal.
hitch_2005.opis_en_tmdb: Dating coach Alex 'Hitch' Hitchens mentors a bumbling client, Albert, who hopes to win the heart of the glamorous Allegra Cole. While Albert makes progress, Hitch faces his own romantic setbacks when proven techniques fail to work on Sara Melas, a tabloid reporter digging for dirt on Allegra Cole's love life. When Sara discovers Hitch's connection to Albert – now Allegra's boyfriend – it threatens to destroy both relationships.

out of reach_2004.opis_neo:
Bivši tajni agent odkrije, da program za rejence ne pomaga otrokom, temveč gre za mrežo trgovine z ljudmi.

Billy Ray Lancing (Steven Seagal) je bivši agent, ki živi umirjeno življenje. Pogosto si dopisuje z mlado Poljakinjo Ireno, ki ji finančno pomaga skozi program posvojitve. Ko pisma prenehajo prihajati, se Billy odpravi poiskati odgovore.
out of reach_2004.opis_omdb: Vietnam veteran Billy Ray Lancing, a former CSA agent who now works on a wildlife refuge in Northern Alaska, has been exchanging letters in a pen-pal relationship with Irina Morawska, a 13-year-old orphaned girl in Poland that he's helping out financially. When the letters suddenly stop coming, Billy heads to Poland to figure out why -- only to discover that the orphanage that Irena was staying in, which is financed by honest -- and unsuspecting -- good-intentioned Samaritans, is a cover for a human trafficking network. Run by a man named Faisal, the operation is worth billions -- girls are sold and traded to the highest bidders from all over the world. Through Billy's letters to Irina, Billy has taught Irina how to use secret codes, which she uses to keep Billy updated on where Faisal is taking her to. That's how Billy stays on Faisal's trail as Billy teams up with local cop Kasia Lato to rescue Irina and the other girls, and bring down Faisal's human trafficking network.

she's the man_2006.opis_neo:
Viola se naseli v študentski dom, kjer se izdaja za svojega brata, tam pa se zaljubi v nogometaša iz njegove ekipe.

Viola (Amanda Bynes) se začne preoblačiti v svojega brata dvojčka Sebastiana (James Kirk) in prevzemati njegovo mesto v internatski šoli Illyria Prep. Njen brat je namreč zaradi poskusa preboja na glasbeno sceno dlje časa odsoten. Vendar ni računala na to, da se bo zaljubila v svojega oz. bratovega čednega cimra Duka (Channing Tatum), ki pa je zaljubljen v prelepo Olivio (Laura Ramsey). 

Zadeva se še bolj zaplete, ko se Olivia zaljubi v Sebastiana, ki je ravno prav čustven fant, kakršnega si je od nekdaj želela spoznati. Toda to še ni konec. Pravi Sebastian se vrne iz Londona dva dni prej, ne da bi vedel, da ga je zamenjala njegova sestra dvojčica.
she's the man_2006.opis_omdb: Here's the thing! Viola's soccer team at Cornwall gets cut. She wants to join the boys' team, but they do not allow girls. So she thinks, "If you can't beat them, join them". So she does! She disguises herself as her twin brother, Sebastian and goes out for the rival school, Illyria Boys' Soccer Team and makes it. Unfortunately, she didn't plan falling in love with her roommate Duke. But Duke has his eyes on Olivia. What makes matters worse is that Olivia starts to fall for Sebastian because he/she has a sensitive side. If things couldn't get more problematic, the real Sebastian (who was in London working on his music) comes home early. He arrives on campus and has no clue that he was replaced by his twin sister.

ace ventura: when nature calls_1995.opis_neo:
Živalski detektiv se po vrnitvi z duhovnega popotovanja loti preiskave izginotja redkega belega netopirja, ki je sveta žival nekega afriškega plemena.

Detektiv za pogrešane živali Ace Ventura se v tokratni pustolovščini napoti v afriško džunglo. Tam mora poiskati skrivnostno izginulega svetega belega netopirja, ki je simbol nekega afriškega plemena. S svojo pojavo Ace povzroči pravi kaos in kot za šalo pomete s komerkoli, ki mu pride na pot. Seveda mu pri tem pomagajo kosmati in pernati ter novi človeški prijatelji.
ace ventura: when nature calls_1995.opis_omdb: Ace Ventura, emerging from self-imposed exile in a remote Himalayan hideaway, travels to Africa with explorer Fulton Greenwall to find a sacred bat which is told will avert a war between with Wachootoo and Wachati tribes. Of course, when Ace gets involved, all hell breaks loose...
ace ventura: when nature calls_1995.opis_sl_tmdb: Ace Ventura, živalski detektiv, se vrne z duhovnega popotovanja, da bi raziskal izginotje redkega belega netopirja, svete živali plemena v Afriki.
ace ventura: when nature calls_1995.opis_en_tmdb: Summoned from an ashram in Tibet, Ace finds himself on a perilous journey into the jungles of Africa to find Shikaka, the missing sacred animal of the friendly Wachati tribe. He must accomplish this before the wedding of the Wachati's Princess to the prince of the warrior Wachootoos. If Ace fails, the result will be a vicious tribal war.

terminator salvation_2009.opis_neo:
Leta 2018 pride skrivnostno novo orožje - pol človek, pol stroj - k Johnu Connorju na predvečer napada na Skynet. Na čigavi strani je? Mu lahko zaupa?

John Connor je zadnje upanje človeštva v vojni proti strojem, zato organizira odporniško gibanje, s katerim bi uničili Skynet, inteligentno računalniško omrežje, ki iztreblja človeštvo. Pri tem spozna svojega očeta Kyla Reesa in skrivnostnega neznanca Marcusa, ki bi lahko odigral pomembno vlogo v boju, toda le če si pridobi Connorjevo zaupanje.
terminator salvation_2009.opis_omdb: In 2003, in the Longview State Correctional Facility, the criminal Marcus Wright is on death row, and is convinced by the cancerous Dr. Serena Kogan to donate his body to her research and he accepts. In 2018, after an unsuccessful attack to a Skynet facility, only John Connor survives, but he discovers that Skynet is developing the powerful new model T-800. Out of the blue, Marcus appears naked and with amnesia in the location. Marcus befriends the teenager Kyle Reese and the girl Star who help him to survive the lethal machines and they travel together in a Jeep. Meanwhile the resistance discovers a signal that might turn-off the machines and John offers to test it. Poveljnik specialnih enot povede vojake v nigerijski pragozd, da bi rešili zdravnico. Ta se jim bo pridružila le, če s seboj vzamejo še 70 beguncev.

Poročnik Waters dobi nalogo, da izvleče ameriško zdravico iz okupirane Nigerije. Dr. Lena Kendricks noče zapustiti ranjencev, za katere skrbi, zato Watersa in njegovo ekipo prepriča, naj jim omogočijo pot skozi nevarno džunglo, ki je pod nadzorom upornikov.
tears of the sun_2003.opis_omdb: Navy SEAL Lieutenant A.K. Waters and his elite squadron of tactical specialists are forced to choose between their duty and their humanity, between following orders by ignoring the conflict that surrounds them, or finding the courage to follow their conscience and protect a group of innocent refugees. When the democratic government of Nigeria collapses and the country is taken over by a ruthless military dictator, Waters, a fiercely loyal and hardened veteran is dispatched on a routine mission to retrieve a Doctors Without Borders physician, Dr. Lena Kendricks. Dr. Kendricks, an American citizen by marriage, is tending to the victims of the ongoing civil war at a Catholic mission in a remote village. When Waters arrives, however, Dr. Kendricks refuses to leave unless he promises to help deliver the villagers to political asylum at the nearby border. If they are left behind, they will be at the mercy of the enormous rebel army. Waters is under strict orders from his commanding officer Captain Bill Rhodes to remain disengaged from the conflict. But as he and his men witness the brutality of the rebels first-hand, they are won over to Dr. Kendricks' cause and place their lives at risk by agreeing to escort the villagers on a perilous trek through the dense jungle. As they move through the countryside on foot, Waters' team, experts at evasion and concealment, are inexplicably and ferociously pursued by an army of rebels. They are confounded until they discover that, among the refugees, is the sole survivor of the country's previous ruling family, whom the rebels have been ordered to eliminate at all costs. Waters and his small band of soldiers must weigh the life of one man against their own and the refugees they feel obliged to protect.

the crucifixion_2017.opis_en_tmdb: When a priest is jailed for the murder of a nun on whom he was performing an exorcism, an investigative journalist strives to determine whether he in fact murdered a mentally ill person, or if he lost the battle with a demonic presence.

extra ordinary_2019.opis_neo:
Zabavna in strašljiva komedija o ženski z nadnaravnimi sposobnostmi, ki pomaga obupanemu očetu rešiti uročeno hčerko iz krempljev blaznega satanista.

Rose, prikupna in osamljena inštruktorica na irskem podeželju ima nadnaravne sposobnosti. Skuša se ne zmeniti za vztrajne prošnje domačinov, naj izžene duhove iz obsedenih smetnjakov ali uročenega proda. Toda, ko lokalna rock zvezda sklene zavezo s hudičem in začara mlado dekle, je Rose primorana premagati strah pred svojim darom in ji pomagati.
extra ordinary_2019.opis_omdb: Rose, a sweet, lonely driving instructor in rural Ireland, is gifted with supernatural abilities. Rose has a love/hate relationship with her 'talents' & tries to ignore the constant spirit related requests from locals - to exorcise possessed rubbish bins or haunted gravel. But! Christian Winter, a washed up, one-hit-wonder rock star, has made a pact with the devil for a return to greatness! He puts a spell on a local teenager- making her levitate. Her terrified father, Martin Martin, asks Rose to help save his daughter. Rose has to overcome the fear of her supernatural gift & work with Martin to save the girl, get the guy and be home in time for a light snack...maybe a yogurt or something...
extra ordinary_2019.opis_sl_tmdb: Rose, prikupna in osamljena inštruktorica vožnje na irskem podeželju, ima nadnaravne sposobnosti, a zavrača vztrajne prošnje domačinov, naj poskrbi za njihove smetnjake, obsedene z duhovi. Ko pa krajevni rokovski zvezdnik sklene zavezo s hudičem in začara mlado dekle, je Rose primorana premagati strah pred svojim darom in ob pomoči obupanega očeta pomagati dekletu.
extra ordinary_2019.opis_en_tmdb: A driving instructor must use her other-worldly gifts to save a lonely man’s daughter from a rock star looking to use her for Satanic purposes.

marmaduke_2022.opis_neo:
Ko ena od Marmadukovih veličastnih polomij preplavi splet, posnetek pritegne pozornost znanega pasjega učitelja, ki sprejme izziv, da bo iz Marmaduka naredil prvaka na svetovni pasji razstavi.

Naš junak je simpatična (vendar neukrotljiva) nemška doga, ki je najsrečnejši, ko se zabava s svojo družino, Winslowimi, še posebej, ko se igra kavbojce z devetletnim Billyjem. Toda naj se še tako trudijo, zdi se, da Winslowi preprosto ne zmorejo preprečiti Marmaduku, da ne bi vedno znova zabredel v težave. Ko ena od Marmadukovih veličastnih polomij preplavi splet, posnetek pritegne pozornost znanega pasjega učitelja, ki sprejme izziv, da bo iz Marmaduka naredil prvaka na svetovni pasji razstavi. Sledi burna pustolovščina, čeprav ne takšna, kot bi pričakovali. Na koncu bodo Marmaduke in Winslowi dojeli, da v življenju ni najpomembneje zmagovati, temveč ostati zvest sebi in tistim, ki jih imaš rad.

winchester_2018.opis_neo:
Ekscentrična dedinja Sarah Winchester je prepričana, da jo preganjajo duše ljudi, ki so jih ubile puške znamke Winchester.

Film predstavlja zgodbo, navdihnjeno z resnično Sarah Winchester (Helen Mirren) in prikazuje ekscentrično naslednico z orožjem pridobljenega bogastva, ki je prepričana, da jo preganjajo duše tisti, ki so bili ubiti z orožjem znamke winchester. Legenda pravi, da je Sarah Winchester verjela, da bo živa, dokler bo gradila svojo hišo. Film se je snemal na avtentični lokaciji, kar je bilo izjemno težko in zapleteno za filmsko ekipo zaradi stisnjene hiše. Sarah Winchester je neskončno dolgo in ves čas gradila to hišo v prepričanju, da če jo bo nehala, se bodo duhovi umrlih spravili nadnjo in jo na koncu ubili. Hišo je gradila celih 38 let. Toda njena gradnja je bila rahlo bizarna, glede na to, da se razna vrata in okna odpirajo v zidove ali pa preprosto ne vodijo nikamor.
winchester_2018.opis_omdb: Inspired by true events. On an isolated stretch of land fifty miles outside of San Francisco sits the most haunted house in the world. Built by Sarah Winchester (Dame Helen Mirren) heiress to the Winchester fortune, it is a house that knows no end. Constructed in an incessant twenty-four hour a day, seven day a week mania for decades, it stands seven stories tall and contains hundreds of rooms. To an outsider it looks like a monstrous monument to a disturbed woman's madness. But Sarah is not building for herself, for her niece Marion (Sarah Snook), nor for the brilliant Dr. Eric Price (Jason Clarke), who she has summoned to the house. She is building a prison, an asylum for hundreds of vengeful ghosts, and the most terrifying amongst them have a score to settle with the Winchesters.

the hunger games: mockingjay part 2_2015.opis_neo:
V zadnjem delu Iger lakote je Panem v vojni, Katniss pa se s skupino svojih najbližjih prijateljev v zadnjem obračunu sooči s predsednikom Snowom.

V velikem finalu epskega globalnega fenomena Igre lakote se Katniss Everdeen zave, da je na kocki veliko več kot zgolj preživetje - tokrat se bori za prihodnost. Medtem ko njen narod bije kruto vojno, se Katniss sooči s samim predsednikom Snowom. S svojimi zvestimi prijatelji organizira poskus atentata na predsednika, ki postaja čedalje nevarnejši in obseden z željo, da jo uniči. Smrtonosne pasti, številni sovražniki in težke moralne dileme bodo za Katniss predstavljale največji izziv doslej.
the hunger games: mockingjay part 2_2015.opis_omdb: After young Katniss Everdeen agrees to be the symbol of rebellion, the Mockingjay, she tries to return Peeta to his normal state, tries to get to the Capitol, and tries to deal with the battles coming her way...but all for her main goal: assassinating President Snow and returning peace to the Districts of Panem. As her squad starts to get smaller and smaller, will she make it to the Capitol? Will she get revenge on Snow or will her target change? Will she be with her "Star-Crossed Lover," Peeta, or her long-time friend, Gale? Deaths, bombs, bow and arrows, a love triangle, hope... What will happen?
the hunger games: mockingjay part 2_2015.opis_sl_tmdb: Ker je država Panem v polno razširjeni vojni, se Katniss sooči s predsednikom Snowom in skupino svojih najbližjih prijateljev.
the hunger games: mockingjay part 2_2015.opis_en_tmdb: As the war between the Capitol and the districts reaches its peak, Katniss Everdeen embarks on a perilous mission to liberate Panem and confront President Snow. Joined by a team of trusted allies, she navigates deadly traps, shifting loyalties, and the heavy cost of rebellion, determined to bring freedom to her people and end the Hunger Games once and for all.

bookworm_2024.opis_neo:
Ko gre Mildredina mama v bolnišnico, pride oče na Novo Zelandijo, da bi skrbel za hčer, ki jo bo zdaj srečal prvič.

Mildred je bistra 11-letnica. Ob mami samohranilki je pobegnila pred dolgočasjem v predmestju tako, da se je potopila v knjižne pustolovščine. Išče dokaz, da je mitološka zver resnična. Njen oče je Strawn Wise, bivši ameriški iluzionist, ki zdaj na zabavah izdeluje živali iz balonov. Ko gre Mildredina mama v bolnišnico, pride oče na Novo Zelandijo, da bi skrbel za hčer, ki jo bo zdaj srečal prvič.
bookworm_2024.opis_omdb: 11-year-old Mildred's world is turned upside down when her estranged father, the washed-up magician Strawn Wise, comes to look after her and agrees to take her camping to find a mythological beast known as the Canterbury Panther.
bookworm_2024.opis_sl_tmdb: Življenje 11-letne Mildred se obrne na glavo, ko njena mati pristane v bolnišnici in zanjo začne skrbeti odtujeni oče, ameriški čarovnik Strawn Wise. V upanju, da bo razvedril najstnico, ki je pravi knjižni črvek, jo odpelje na taborjenje v težko dostopno, razgibano novozelandsko divjino. Z namenom preizkusa družinske povezanosti, se lotita iskanje mitološke zveri, znane kot Canterburyjski panter.
bookworm_2024.opis_en_tmdb: Eleven-year-old Mildred’s life is turned upside down when her mother lands in hospital and estranged, American magician father, Strawn Wise, comes to look after her.  Hoping to entertain the bookish tween, Strawn takes Mildred camping in the notoriously rugged New Zealand wilderness, and the pair embark on the ultimate test of family bonding – a quest to find the mythological beast known as the Canterbury Panther.

Srhljivi horor triler s priljubljenim Davidom Tennantom v glavni vlogi, najbolj znanem po svoji inkarnaciji Doktorja v kultni nadaljevanki Dr. Who.

Prijatelja delata v dragi restavraciji in izvajata manjše tatvine v hišah premožnih gostov, medtem, ko ti obedujejo v restavraciji. Nekega večera se spravita na hišo nadležnega gosta, v kateri odkrijeta z verigami priklenjeno žensko. Potem, ko obvestita policijo in skušata rešiti žrtev razvpitega psihopata, še sama postaneta njegova tarča.
bad samaritan_2018.opis_omdb: In Portland, the amateurish photographer Sean Falco works with his best friend Derek Sandoval as valet at a fancy restaurant. His girlfriend Riley Seabrook studies in a university and he is estranged of his stepfather. Sean and Derek are also smalltime burglars, stealing from the houses of the customers while they are eating in the restaurant. One day, the obnoxious client Cale Erendreich arrives at the restaurant driving a Maserati and Sean drives his car back to his house using the computer and Derek watches Cale in the restaurant. While snooping around the house, Sean finds a locked room and when he opens the door, he stumbles upon a woman tied to a chair with chains and gagged. He unsuccessfully tries to release her but he is forced to return to the restaurant with the Maserati. Sean decides to call the police, but Cale fools the police officers and turns Sean's life upside-down.

Zakonca skušata rešiti njuno propadajočo mesnico, tako da začneta loviti ljudi, ki prakticirajo veganstvo in prodajata njihovo meso.

Vincent in Sophie sta mesečnika, ki jima propadata posel in zakon. Nekega dne pa se njuno življenje za vselej spremeni, ko Vincent po nesreči ubije aktivista vegana, ki je uničil njuno mesnico. Da bi se znebil trupla, naredi iz njega šunko, ki jo njegova soproga po nesreči proda. Kupci niso še nikoli toliko povpraševali po kakšni šunki! Zdaj sta v skušnjavi, ali bi ponovno morila.
barbaque_2021.opis_omdb: Pascal and his wife Sophie have been running a small local butcher's shop for about twenty years. Sophie stands with great love for her customers at the cash register and Vincent cuts the carefully selected meat with just as much love. And they lived happily ever after, you might think. But then, as is the case with many small tradesmen, business went downhill and so did their relationship. After almost 30 years of marriage, the marriage bed is as alive as the sausages in the counter. Mutual irritation hinders any form of dialogue. Love, business - nothing works out, so Sophie seeks refuge in her great passion: TV shows about serial killers. Vincent unleashes all his love on Pépère, his gentle rottweiler.

ta'igara: an adventure in the himalayas_.naslov_orig: Ta'igara: An Adventure in the Himalayas
ta'igara: an adventure in the himalayas_.opis_neo:
Pustolovski družinski film, ki se odvija v tropskih gozdovih Himalaje.

V himalajski dolini osiroteli deček reši mladiča bengalskega tigra pred neusmiljenimi divjimi lovci, ki so tigrčku ubili mamo. Skupaj se odpravita v goro k samostanu Takcang v Butanu, ki mu pravijo tudi Tigrovo gnezdo, kamor so se budistični menihi umaknili pred kitajsko invazijo na Tibet leta 1950, da bi zaščitili te grandiozne velike mačke. Deček in tiger bosta morala skupaj prepotovati dolgo pot, se soočiti z nevarnostjo, ki preži v gorah, ter prenesti težke vremenske razmere, da bi prišla do tigrčkovega novega doma visoko v Himalaji. Skupaj bosta doživela svojo največjo pustolovščino: pravo prijateljstvo!

ta'igara: an adventure in the himalayas_.opis_en_tmdb: In the valleys of the Himalayas, an orphan boy saves a Bengal tiger cub from the ruthless poachers who killed the tiger's mother. Together they set out in the Himalayan mountains to the Taktsang monastery in Bhutan known as "The Tiger's Nest" where Buddhist monks took refuge after the 1950 Chinese invasion of Tibet and protect the big cats. A new great film for the whole family that talks about the importance of defending animals through the story of the friendship between two orphans, a tiger cub and a child, in a tale of brotherhood and the discovery of life.

the new daughter_2009.opis_neo:
Do kam bi šel oče, da bi hči zaščitil pred starodavnim zlom, ki jo prevzema?

John se po ločitvi z otrokoma preseli na podeželje. Blizu nove posesti trojica najde skrivnostno gomilo, nad katero se navduši Johnova hči in vse več časa preživi na njej. Njeno vedenje začne postajati vse bolj čudaško. Do kam bi šel oče, da bi hči zaščitil pred starodavnim zlom, ki jo prevzema?
the new daughter_2009.opis_omdb: John James is a writer; his wife has left him. He moves with his middle-school aged daughter and young son to an isolated house off a dirt road in South Carolina. The property has an Indian burial mound, which fascinates his daughter, Louisa, who's entering puberty. Strange things: noises on the roof and in the woods, the cat missing, Luisa sleepwalking clutching a straw doll no one's seen before. She visits the mound often, staying late, coming home covered with mud. John's younger son, Sam, is frightened. John learns the house has a history and seeks out the previous owner. Louisa's behavior becomes more bizarre. Is there an explanation? An ant farm and a missing babysitter provide clues.

brimstone_2016.opis_neo:
Epska zgodba o mladi ženski, ki se v Kanadi v času Divjega zahoda bojuje za svojo in za svobodo svoje družine.

Liz je borbena ženska, ki ji ne manjka poguma in odločnosti, kljub temu, da ne more govoriti. Ko v mesto prispe nov duhovnik se Liz zave, da je v nevarnosti, saj se ji psihopatski fanatik želi maščevati zaradi grehov, ki naj bi jih zagrešila v preteklosti. Toda Liz ne sprejme vloge žrtve in je pripravljena na boj za preživetje, v tem peklu na Zemlji.
brimstone_2016.opis_omdb: A triumphant epic of survival and a tale of powerful womanhood and resistance against the unforgiving cruelty of a hell on earth. Our heroine is Liz (Dakota Fanning), carved from the beautiful wilderness, full of heart and grit, hunted by a vengeful Preacher (Guy Pearce) - a diabolical zealot and her twisted nemesis. But Liz is a genuine survivor; she's no victim - a woman of fearsome strength who responds with astonishing bravery to claim the better life she and her daughter deserve. Fear not. Retribution is coming.

Alexandre Aja, eden najperspektivnejših mladih francoskih režiserjev, vpelje Cécile de France in Maïwenn v noč srhljive groze najstrašnejšega Philippa Nahona. Film oživi pomembno tradicijo filmov o nočnih morah in spremlja lov morilca, ki se ne ustavi pred ničimer, na dekleti, ki bosta prestopili svoje meje. Sledi groza. Kriminalka z obrati, ob katerih vam bo zamrznila kri v žilah.

Late that night, a sick, sadistic killer breaks into the farmhouse, slaughters Alexia's family--including their dog--and kidnaps Alexia. Marie hides from the criminal and tries to help terrified, hysterical Alexia, chase the maniac, and disclose his identity in the end.
haute tension_2003.opis_sl_tmdb: Študentki Marie in Alex se odpravita na osamljeno kmetijo, ki pa se že prvo noč spremeni v pravo morišče, ko se od nekod prikaže psihopatski morilec. haute tension_2003.opis_en_tmdb: Best friends Marie and Alexia decide to spend a quiet weekend at Alexia's parents' secluded farmhouse. But on the night of their arrival, the girls' idyllic getaway turns into an endless night of horror.

astérix & obélix contre césar_1999.opis_neo:
Prebivalci zadnje neosvojene vasi v Galiji uporabljajo čarobni napoj, da bi se obranili pred rimskimi napadalci.

Rimski cesar Gaj Julij Cezar se odpravi v edino Galsko vasico, ki se še upira njegovemu cesarstvu, kjer izve, da Galcem v boju proti Rimljanom pomaga poseben čarobni napoj. Debelušni Obelix, ki je kot majhen padel v kotel z napojem, je še posebej nepremagljiv. Rimljani, ki se želijo rešiti galske nadloge, načrtujejo ugrabitev zdravilca, ki ima recept za pripravo napoja, in najmočnejšega izmed vseh Galcev, simpatičnega Obelixa.
astérix & obélix contre césar_1999.opis_omdb: The well-known little village from the Asterix and Obelix-comic books is in trouble: It is the last place not controlled by Rome. When Tax collector Claudius Incorruptus does not get his money from the villagers, Julius Caesar himself comes to the place to see what's so special about their resistance. A special magic potion, prepared by the village's druid, gives incredible power to those who drink it. And Obelix, who fell into the pot as a child has been invincible ever since. With the help of Tullius Destructivus, an intrigeur, the Romans try to get Obelix and the druid into their hands in order to wipe the little village off the map, when the last potion of it's stock has been used up. But each individual also has some plans of his own...

a haunted house_2013.opis_omdb: In October 2012 a video footage is found at the home of Malcolm Johnson and the recordings are still unexplained. Past this prologue a story in flashback form unfolds. During the summer of 2012, Malcolm and Kisha move in together and start a happy life. One night Kisha notices a few unexplained phenomena that convince her their house is haunted by ghosts. To allay her fears Malcom hires a camera crew to film inside the house day and night. A few nights later Malcom and Keisha have sex on camera, despite Keisha's protests at being filmed. Upon reviewing the sex tape the next day, Malcom and Keisha notice a few paranormal phenomena caught on tape. Malcom wants to sell the house but the housing market is slow. Therefore, Malcom decides to hire a psychic to come to the house and investigate. After Kisha confesses to making a deal with the devil for a pair of shoes things start to make sense but it doesn't solve the problems caused by the paranormal phenomena.

jeanne d'arc_1999.opis_neo:
Najstnica Ivana Orleanska je spremenila potek zgodovine. Navdihnili so jo glasovi, ki jih je slišala, in povsem je presenetila angleške okupatorje.

Leta 1412 se v francoskem mestecu Domrémy rodi mala Ivana. Časi so težki, stoletna vojna s Francijo traja že od leta 1337 in angleški vojaki brezsrčno pustošijo po deželi. Ivana odraste v skrajno pobožno dekle, k spovedi gre nekajkrat na dan. Pri trinajstih ima prvi privid in najde meč. Ob vrnitvi domov najde rodno vas požgano do tal. Leta 1428 se zave, da je njena naloga rešiti Francoze izpod angleškega jarma in se poda v glavno mesto, da se sreča z dofenom Karlom. Le-ta, sredi obupnega vojnega položaja, sprejme vsako pomoč, ki jo lahko dobi, in mladenki da priložnost, da dokaže svojo od boga dodeljeno nalogo. Po uspešni osvoboditvi Orléansa in Reimsa je dofen lahko po tradiciji okronan v katedrali v Reimsu in Ivane ne potrebuje več, saj so se mu izpolnile vse želje. Ivana Orleanska pade v njegovo zanko in postane ujetnica Burgundcev …
jeanne d'arc_1999.opis_omdb: 1429. While the war between France and England (the Hundred Years War) appeared settled in 1420, in England's favour, the death of King Henry V of England reignites it. England occupies large areas of France and appears set to take the whole of it. Into this moment of crisis rides legendary Joan of Arc, a teenage girl who claims to be lead by divine visions.

Leta 1412 se v francoskem mestecu Domrémy rodi mala Ivana. Časi so težki, stoletna vojna s Francijo traja že od leta 1337 in angleški vojaki brezsrčno pustošijo po deželi. Ivana odraste v skrajno pobožno dekle, k spovedi gre nekajkrat na dan. Pri trinajstih ima prvi privid in najde meč. Ob vrnitvi domov najde rodno vas požgano do tal. Leta 1428 se zave, da je njena naloga rešiti Francoze izpod angleškega jarma in se poda v glavno mesto, da se sreča z dofenom Karlom. Le-ta, sredi obupnega vojnega položaja, sprejme vsako pomoč, ki jo lahko dobi, in mladenki da priložnost, da dokaže svojo od boga dodeljeno nalogo. Po uspešni osvoboditvi Orléansa in Reimsa je dofen lahko po tradiciji okronan v katedrali v Reimsu in Ivane ne potrebuje več, saj so se mu izpolnile vse želje. Ivana Orleanska pade v njegovo zanko in postane ujetnica Burgundcev …
jeanne d'arc_1999.opis_en_tmdb: In 1429, a French teenager stood before her King with a message she claimed came from God; that she would defeat the world's greatest army and liberate her country from its political and religious turmoil. As she reclaims God's diminished kingdom, this courageous young woman has various amazing victories until her violent and untimely death.

hopper et le hamster des ténèbres_2022.naslov_orig: Hopper et le hamster des ténèbres
hopper et le hamster des ténèbres_2022.opis_neo:
Mladi junak Kokozajec je kljub svoji nerodnosti obseden s pustolovščinami.

Kokozajec, nekoliko nenavaden superjunak, posvojenec znanega pustolovca, kralja Peter, si želi - kljub svoji drugačnosti - biti del družbe in biti ljubljen,; obseden je s pustolovščinami, čeprav ni ravno najbolj spretne sorte. Ko iz zapora pobegne najhujši zločinec v kraljestvu - njegov lastni stric Lapin - in zagrozi, da bo s prestola vrgel njegovega očeta, se Kokozajec poda na dirko epskih razsežnosti, da prepreči njegove nakane. Njegovo iskanje Mračnega hrčka postane prava poučna dogodivščina, sploh ob prijateljih, kakršna sta želva Abe in dihurka Meg.
hopper et le hamster des ténèbres_2022.opis_omdb: Set in a lush fantasy world, the film follows the adventures of Chickenhare, a young hero born half chicken and half hare, who was adopted by King Peter, a famous hare adventurer. Eager to fit in and feel loved in spite of his differences, Chickenhare is obsessed with adventuring - no matter how clumsy he is. When the Kingdom's greatest villain - his own uncle - escapes from jail and threatens to overthrow his father, Chickenhare embarks on an epic and initiatory quest along with Abe, a sarcastic turtle, and Meg, a martial arts expert skunk, to stop him.
hopper et le hamster des ténèbres_2022.opis_sl_tmdb: Kokozajec je posvojenec slavnega pustolovca, kralja Petra. Kljub svojemu nenavadnemu videzu in precejšnji nerodnosti si močno želi, da bi ga družba sprejela in vzljubila, zato je obseden z iskanjem pustolovščin. Zgodba se zaplete, ko iz zapora pobegne največji zločinec v kraljestvu - Kokozajčev lastni stric Lapin. Lapin grozi, da bo očeta vrgel s prestola in zavladal kraljestvu. Da bi ga ustavil, se Kokozajec skupaj s sarkastično želvo Abejem in pogumno strokovnjakinjo za borilne veščine, tvorko Meg, poda na nevarno potovanje, polno pasti, izzivov in smeha.
hopper et le hamster des ténèbres_2022.opis_en_tmdb: Young Chickenhare is the adopted son of King Peter, a famous adventurer. Part chicken and part hare, he has a really tough time growing up and disguises himself as a hare to avoid the mockeries of his peers. When the day of the Royal Adventurer Society trials comes, Chickenhare, hampered by his disguise, fails miserably. But he is determined to grab a second chance and find the Scepter of the Hamster of Darkness, before his evil Uncle Lapin. The Scepter will give immense power to its holder. If Lapin gets hold of it, he will be unstoppable. Accompanied by his faithful servant Abe, a sarcastic turtle, and Meg, a martial arts expert skunk, he sets of on an epic and initiatory quest.

eliza graves_2014.opis_neo:
V 19. stoletju se mlad zdravnik zaposli v umobolnici in ugotovi, da so revolucionarne nove metode nečloveške ter da se tam dogaja nekaj nenavadnega.

Film je posnet po eni najbolj napetih zgodb genialnega Edgarja Allana Poeja! Zgodba tega srhljivega trilerja se dogaja v 19. stoletju. Umobolnica na samem Stonehearst Asylum je daleč od oči javnosti, v njej pa se zaposli mladi zdravnik Edward Newgate. Kmalu opazi, da se znotraj njenih zidov dogajajo čudne reči, pritegne pa ga tudi prelepa bolnica Eliza Graves.
eliza graves_2014.opis_omdb: A couple of days before 1899 Christmas, the Oxford new graduate Dr. Edward Newgate arrives at the Stonehearst Asylum to complete training for his specialty of asylum medicine. He is met by armed men who take him to Dr. Silas Lamb, who welcomes his help and takes him under his wing. Edward is shocked to see the methods that Dr. Lamb uses to run this asylum. He becomes infatuated with Eliza Graves, one of the patients who is a lady of status and does not seem to belong. One night, Edward overhears a knocking from the bowels of the facility and is shocked to find that everything is not as it seems in this place and that his uneasy feelings may be justified. What will Edward Choose?

eliza graves_2014.opis_en_tmdb: An Oxford Medical School graduate takes a position at a mental institution and soon becomes obsessed with a female mental patient, but he has no idea of a recent and horrifying staffing change.

valérian et la cité des mille planètes_2.naslov_orig: Valérian et la Cité des mille planètes
valérian et la cité des mille planètes_2.opis_neo:
Temačne sile grozijo metropoli, ki je dom bitjem iz tisočih planetov. Posebna agenta morata poiskati grožnjo ter rešiti mesto in celo vesolje.

Valerian in Laureline sta posebna vladna agenta, zadolžena za ohranjanje reda in miru v vsem vesolju v 28. stoletju. Potujeta skozi čas in dimenzije, da lahko ščitita galaksije in mir v vesolju. Poveljnik (Clive Owen) ju pošlje z ukazom na misijo v medgalaktično mesto Alfa, rastočo metropolo, ki jo sestavlja tisoče planetov. Alfa ima 20 milijonov prebivalcev, ki so združili svoje znanje, tehnologijo in vire za blaginjo vseh. Vendar pa nimajo vsi v Alfi enakih interesov in ciljev; nevidne sile namreč ogrožajo mesto.
valérian et la cité des mille planètes_2.opis_omdb: In the twenty-eighth century, space station Alpha is a city where beings from different planets live together exchanging their knowledge and culture. Peace is granted by a human force, including Major Valerian (Dane DeHaan) and his partner Sergeant Laureline (Cara Delevingne). They are assigned by the Defense Minister (Herbie Hancock) to retrieve the last species of converter in a dangerous mission. They succeed and back to Alpha, unknown humanoids abduct Commander Arun Filitt (Clive Owen) expecting to steal the converter. They head to a forbidden area that is infected, but Valerian and Laureline follow them and disclose a hidden secret about the race and the infected area.

valérian et la cité des mille planètes_2.opis_en_tmdb: In the 28th century, Valerian and Laureline are special operatives charged with keeping order throughout the human territories. the physician_2013.opis_neo:
Zgodba se odvija v 11. stoletju in spremlja Roba Cola, ki ima posebno moč, da začuti, kdaj človek umira.

Zgodba se odvija v 11. stoletju in spremlja Roba, ki ima posebno moč, da začuti kdaj človek umira. Postane pomočnik potujočega mazača, a ga želja po znanju vodi v Perzijo, v najslavnejšo šolo za zdravnike, ki jo vodi Ibn Sina. Da bi ga sprejeli v muslimanski svet, mora Rob skrivati svoje krščansko poreklo.
the physician_2013.opis_omdb: When nine-year-old Rob Cole felt the life force slipping from his mother's hand he could not foresee that this terrifying awareness of impending death was a gift that would lead him from the familiar life of 11th-century London to small villages throughout England and finally to the medical school at Ispahan. Though apprenticed to an itinerant barber surgeon, it is the dazzling surgery of a Jewish physician trained by the legendary Persian physician Avicenna that inspires him to accept his gift and to commit his life to healing by studying at Avicenna's school. Despite the ban on Christian students, Rob goes there, disguising himself as a Jew to gain admission. Gordon has written an adventurous and inspiring tale of a quest for medical knowledge pursued in a violent world full of superstition and prejudice.
the physician_2013.opis_sl_tmdb: Zgodba se odvija v 11. stoletju in spremlja Roba Cola, ki ima posebno moč, da lahko začuti, kdaj človek umira. Po materini smrti pristane pri potujočem mazaču in postane njegov pomočnik. Toda Rob si želi, da bi se čim več naučil o zdravljenju bolezni, kar ga vodi v Perzijo v najslavnejšo šolo za zdravnike pod vodstvom slavnega Ibn Sina. Da bi ga sprejeli v muslimanski svet, mora Rob skrivati svoje krščansko poreklo in igrati Juda.
the physician_2013.opis_en_tmdb: England, 1021: Born in a miserable mining town, Robert Cole swears to become a physician and vanquish disease and death. His harsh path of many years, a quest for knowledge besieged by countless challenges and sacrifices, leads him to the remote Isfahan, in Persia, where he meets Ibn Sina, the greatest healer of his time.

knock knock_2015.opis_omdb: When a devoted husband and father is left home alone for the weekend, two stranded young women unexpectedly knock on his door for help. What starts out as a kind gesture results in a dangerous seduction and a deadly game of cat and mouse. A sexy new thriller from director Eli Roth and written for the screen by Eli Roth & Nicolás López & Guillermo Amoedo and story by Anthony Overman and Michael Ronald, KNOCK KNOCK stars Keanu Reeves as the family man who falls into temptation and Lorenza Izzo and Ana de Armas as the seductresses who wreak havoc upon his life, turning a married man's dark fantasy into his worst nightmare.

Ko v Indiani v mestu Warshaw postanete detektiv, se udeležite pokrskega večera, kjer igrate proti nekaterim najboljšim policistom.

V Indiani novim detektivom pripravijo pokrski večer, kjer se izbranec pomeri z najboljšimi policisti in posluša njihove anekdote iz službenega vsakdana. Ko se novinec Stan vrača domov s pokrskega večera, ga v roke dobi psihopat in ga zapre v klet. Z zgodbami, ki jih je slišal pri pokru mora preslepiti ugrabitelja ter rešiti sebe in mlado dekle, ki je prav tako zaprto z njim.
poker night_2014.opis_omdb: When you become a detective in Warsaw Indiana - you go to Poker Night, where you play against some of the best cops in the business. They tell you stories about their time on the job - their successes and failures. When new Detective Stan Jeter leaves the game, he is caught by a vicious psychopath and locked in a basement. Using the stories he heard at Poker Night, he must match wits against his captor - and save not only himself, but the young girl trapped in the basement with him. Like Seven and Usual Suspect, Poker Night combines thrills and twists and turns that will leave you guessing till the very end.

Zmajček, ki ne zna leteti, se s prijateljema odpravi na pustolovščino, da bi skupaj rešili njihov otok.

Mali zmajček Kokos ni opravil izpita letenja in ne sme na izlet, ki ga organizira njegov razred. Kot da to ni dovolj, ga zadolžijo za čuvanje nasada ognjene trave, ki zmajem daje edinstveno moč. Kljub temu, da bo vložil veliko truda v nalogo, se ta ne bo izšla po načrtih. Toda vse to zaradi njegovega velikega srca.
der kleine drache kokosnuss_2014.opis_omdb: When Coconut, a young fire dragon, is charged with guarding the fire grass that bestows the unique gift of fire breathing upon his race, it is stolen from under his nose. Coconut sets off on a quest to retrieve the fire grass, joining forces with Oscar the gourmet dragon and Matilda the porcupine along the way. Coconut is surprised to find that other dragon races are unsympathetic to fire dragons. Their special gift seems to make the fire dragons extremely unpopular. When Dragon Island's dormant volcano "wakes up" and starts to spew molten lava, Coconut must brave the heat and fumes to bring back the fire grass. Yet does he really want the island to return to the way things were? Can he figure out a way to unite all the dragon races and save the island from destruction?
der kleine drache kokosnuss_2014.opis_sl_tmdb: Ko zmajčku Kokosu spodleti na testu letenja, za kazen ne sme oditi z vrstniki na šolski izlet, temveč mora stražiti nasade dragocene ognjene trave. A ker je neroden, poleg tega pa se na vsak način želi dokazati, mu tudi to ne gre preveč dobro od rok in se zaplete v številne zabavne dogodivščine.
der kleine drache kokosnuss_2014.opis_en_tmdb: Coconut and his friend Oscar are outsiders on Dragon Island. Coconut is supposed to be a flying dragon but he can't fly and Oscar, a carnivore by nature, is a vegetarian bychoice. Together with the porcupine Matilda they go on fabulous adventures and meet dragons in all shapes and sizes.

mary & max_2009.opis_neo:
Prisrčna zgodba o nenavadnem prijateljstvu.

Skozi 20 let in dve celini spremlja film dopisno razmerje med dvema nadvse različnima dopisovalcema: Mary Dinkle, polnejšo osamljeno osemletnico, ki živi v predmestju Melbourna v Avstraliji, in Maxom Horovitzem, izrazito debelim 44-letnim Židom z Aspergerjevim sindromom, ki živi v newyorškem kaosu. Spremljamo Maryjino odraščanje in Maxovo staranje ter odnos, ki preživi veliko več od vzponov in padcev povprečnega prijateljstva.
mary & max_2009.opis_omdb: In the mid-1970's, a homely, friendless Australian girl of 8 picks a name out of a Manhattan phone book and writes to him; she includes a chocolate bar. She's Mary Dinkle, the only child of an alcoholic mother and a distracted father. He's Max Horowitz, an overweight man with Asperger's, living alone in New York. He writes back, with chocolate. Thus begins a 20-year correspondence, interrupted by a stay in an asylum and a few misunderstandings. Mary falls in love with a neighbor, saves money to have a birthmark removed and deals with loss. Max has a friendship with a neighbor, tries to control his weight, and finally gets the dream job. Will the two ever meet face to face?

Zgodba, postavljena v zgodnje 20. stoletje, spremlja priljubljeno pisateljico in njene dogodivščine s snubci, policaji, pošastmi in drugimi motnjami.

Piše se leto 1922. Neustrašna mlada novinarka Adele Blanc-Sec bi naredila vse za svoj cilj, celo odplula v Egipt izkopavat mumije. Medtem ko odpira sarkofage, zajame Pariz panika - izleglo se je jajce pterodaktila, shranjeno v naravoslovnem muzeju, ki je staro 136 let! Mladi pterodaktil leti nad Parizom in straši meščane. Adele pa se ne pusti motiti. Omenjeni dogodki je sploh ne prestrašijo, njene pustolovščine pa razkrivajo še mnogo nenavadnih presenečenj!
les aventures extraordinaires d'adele bl.opis_omdb: Desperate to cure her near catatonic sister, intrepid authoress Adèle Blanc-Sec braves ancient Egyptian tombs and modern Egyptian lowlife to locate a mummified doctor and get him back to Paris. Her hope is that oddball Professor Espérandieu will then use his unusual powers to bring the doctor back to life so he, in turn, can use his centuries-old skills on the unfortunate sister. In Paris however Espérandieu is already causing mayhem, having brought to life what was a safe museum egg but is now a very active pterodactyl. Paris 1911 may not be the healthiest place to be.

Kot mladenič, poln idealov, se Robin odpravi v križarsko vojno.

Legendarni opevani lopov in bojevnik že celo stoletje spodbuja filmarje, da si o njem izmišljajo vedno nove zgodbe. Prizore za ta film so snemali v Dubrovniku na Stradunu, v trdnjavi Bokar in v pristanišču Posat – zahvaljujoč režiserju Ottu Bathurstu, ki je izmed desetih predlaganih lokacij izbral prav biser Dalmacije. Nova inačica Robina Hooda – vznemirljiva akcijska pustolovščina, polna eksplozij, norih prizorov bojevanj in brezčasne romantike – bo prikazala mladostna leta slovitega roparja in razkrila podrobnosti, ki so Robina spodbodle, da se zunaj zakona bojuje za pravice malega človeka. Kot mladenič, poln idealov, se Robin (Taron Egerton) odpravi v križarsko vojno. Tam doživlja eno razočaranje za drugim, a vseeno postane prekaljen bojevnik. Po povratku v rodno Anglijo mu voljo povsem vzame spoznanje, da je njegova dežela polna korupcije; temu se namerava zoperstaviti. S svojim poveljnikom (Jamie Foxx) sproži upor poti pokvarjenemu kralju.
robin hood: origins_2018.opis_omdb: Robin of Loxley, a lord living in Nottingham, enjoys a good life with his lover, Marian, before he is drafted by the corrupt Sheriff of Nottingham to fight in the Third Crusade against the Saracens. After four years away from England, Robin becomes disillusioned with the Crusades when he fails to prevent his commander, Guy of Gisbourne, from executing prisoners, namely a teenage boy, despite the pleading of the boy's father, which prompts Gisbourne to send Robin back home. When he returns to Nottingham, Robin learns from his old friend Friar Tuck that the Sheriff had him officially declared dead two years prior in order to seize Robin's land and wealth to continue funding the war effort at the behest of the corrupt Cardinal, kicking the citizens from the city and into the coal mine town across the river. Investigating 'the Slags', Robin witnesses the commoners planning to rise against the government that oppresses and exploits them and learns that Marian is now involved with their aspiring leader, Will Tillman. Robin is prevented from making contact with her by the Arab whose son he tried to save. The man introduces himself as Yahya - which he says can be translated to "John" - and proposes that he and Robin work to end the war by stealing the money taken from the people to fund the church's war. Marian seeks Robin upon learning that he is alive, but he chooses not to tell her of his plans for her own protection..

faces in the crowd_2011.opis_omdb: The elementary school teacher Anna Marchant lives with her boyfriend Bryce in a nice apartment and every now and then she meets her best friends Francine and Nina to drink and talk. When Anna is crossing a bridge to meet Bryce, she sees an infamous serial-killer killing a woman. Anna runs but she is attacked by the killer and she falls off the bridge and hits her head. Anna stays in coma for a week and when she awakes, she learns that she has brain damage followed by Prosopagnosia, a disorder of face perception where the ability to recognize faces is impaired, while the ability to recognize other objects may be relatively intact. The police detective Sam Kerrest unsuccessfully tries to force Anna to remember the face of the serial-killer. Now the serial-killer knows that Anna has seen his face, but she is incapable of even recognizing Bryce and her close friends.

Samuel Solomon, profesor književnosti, je bil po tragični smrti svojega dekleta skoraj eno leto brez službe.

Samuel je imel nočne môre, v katerih so žensko brutalno ubili v čudnem obredu. Nenadoma isto žensko, ki jo vsako noč vidi v svojih sanjah, najdejo mrtvo v enakih okoliščinah. Samuel se pritihotapi na prizorišče zločina, kjer sreča Rachel, ki je prav tako sanjala o umoru. 

Skupaj se bosta trudila, da bi odkrila, kdo je skrivnostna ženska, pri čemer vstopita v srhljivi svet, ki ga vodijo figure, ki navdihujejo umetnike skozi vse čase: muze. 

Gre za zrel pristop k nadnaravnemu, prefinjeno vesolje groze, kjer se mora profesor književnosti boriti prti svoji največji ljubezni: poeziji.
muse_2017.opis_omdb: Samuel Salomon, a literature professor, has been off work for almost a year after the tragic death of his girlfriend. Samuel has been suffering from a recurring nightmare in which a woman is brutally murdered by a strange ritual. Suddenly, the same woman who appears every night in his dreams is found dead in exactly the same circumstances. Samuel sneaks into the crime scene and there he meets Rachel who has also dreamed about the murder. Together, they will do whatever they can to discover the identity of the mystery woman, entering a terrifying world controlled by the figures who have inspired artists throughout time: The Muses.

Jacques in Enzo sta stara prijatelja, ki si delita strast do nevarnega športa, prostega potapljanja.

Kultni film o potapljanju, prijateljstvu in ljubezni, ki ga odlikujejo odlična igra, izjemna glasbena podlaga in Bessonovi prelepi posnetki morskih globin. Jacques in Enzo sta potapljača na dah. Njuno rivalstvo se je začelo že v otroštvu in se le še stopnjevalo, v nevarno in samoljubno tekmovanje.
le grand bleu_1988.opis_omdb: Enzo and Jacques have known each other for a long time. Their friendship started in their childhood days in the Mediterranean. They were not real friends in these days, but there was something they both loved and used to do the whole day long: diving. One day Jacques' father, who was a diver too, died in the Mediterranean sea. After that incident Enzo and Jacques lost contact. After several years, Enzo and Jacques had grown up, Johanna, a young clerk in an insurance office, has to go to Peru. There she meets Jacques who is being studied by a group of scientists. He dives for some minutes into ice-cold water and the scientists monitor his physical state that is more like a dolphin than human. Johanna can not believe what she sees and gets very interested in Jacques but she's unable to get acquainted with him. Some weeks later back in her office, she finds out that Jacques will be competing in a diving championship that takes place in Taormina, Sicily. In order to see Jacques again she makes up a story so the firm sends her to Italy for business purposes. In Taormina there is also Enzo, the reigning diving world champion. He knows that only Jacques can challenge and probably beat him. This time Johanna and Jacques get closer, but Jacques, being more a dolphin than man, cannot really commit and his rivalry with Enzo pushes both men into dangerous territory...

The teenager Courtney sees that she has just a couple of hours to live and does not accept the ride of her drunken boyfriend Evan. She walks home but she is killed by a supernatural creature when the timer in her cellphone reaches zero. Meanwhile Evan crashes his car at the same time of her death and he goes to a hospital where the nurse Quinn Harris works. Evan discloses that he is afraid to go into surgery since the app Countdown predicts that he will die at the same time of the surgery. When Evan mysterious dies in an accident at the hospital, Quinn buys a new cellphone and finds that the app is also installed. When she meets Matt Monroe at the parking lot of the store, she learns that his death is predicted for a couple of hours before her and they team-up to look for a means to break the curse.

the himalayas_2015.opis_neo:
Film, posnet po resničnem dogodku, spremlja znanega alpinista, ki se je odpravil na Everest, da bi pripeljal domov truplo svojega prijatelja.

Prijatelja Hong-Gil in Mu-Taek dosežeta vrhunec svoje kariere, ko postaneta 14. moštvo, ki se povzpne na Himalajo, toda poškodba prisili Hong-Gila v upokojitev. Nekaj let pozneje se Mu-Taek med vzponom na Everest ponesreči, zato Hong sestavi ekipo, da bi spravil njegovo truplo z gore. Po resničnem dogodku alpinista, soočenega z največjim izzivom v življenju.
the himalayas_2015.opis_omdb: Following a grueling climb up Kanchenjunga, Hong-gil and Mu-taek become fast friends and partners in climb. The peak of their professional careers comes when they become the 14th team to scale the Himalayas. But the climb came at a price: both sustained injuries and Hong-gil was compelled to retire. Years later, Hong-gil is a renowned lecturer and Mu-taek takes up an assignment to go up Everest. When Hong-gil learns that Mu-taek has gone missing, he blames himself for encouraging the younger man's plans. Looking at a photo of Mu-taek's frozen corpse still trapped on the mountain, he decides to put together a rescue team to retrieve the body. Despite warnings, concerns over his injured leg and treacherous storms, Hong-gil leads the expedition.

paradise hills_2019.opis_neo:
V svetu prihodnosti se mlada ženska zbudi v na videz idilični šoli za prevzgojo mladih dam. A za njenimi zidovi se skrivajo temačne skrivnosti.

V provokativnem režijskem prvencu Alice Waddington se mlada ženska Uma (Emma Roberts) nekega dne zbudi v Paradise Hillsu, vrhunski ustanovi na osamljenem sredozemskem otoku, ki jo vodi Vojvodinja (Milla Jovovich), kamor pošiljajo bogataške družin svoje hčerke, da postanejo popolne različice sebe. Skozi prilagoditvene metode, kamor sodijo tudi bonton, vokalne tehnike, lepotni tretmaji, gimnastika in omejena prehrana, vse telesne in čustvene hipe odstranijo v dveh mesecih. Preobrazba je zajamčena. Uma najde tolažbo in prijateljstvo pri drugih stanovalkah - Chloe (Danielle McDonald), Yui (Awkwafina) in pop zvezdi Amarni (Eiza Gonzalez), vendar pa kmalu dojame, da se za vso to lepoto skriva mračna skrivnost. Začne se tekma s časom, ko skušajo Uma in njene prijateljice pobegniti in se rešiti.
paradise hills_2019.opis_omdb: In an undetermined future, society has divided into two sub-types: upper-class or "Uppers", and the rest of the world, mid and lower-class, named "Lowers". Uma is a privileged young woman who is adamantly against marrying another Upper, named Son. Instead, she falls in love with a working class young man named Markus. She is thus sent to Paradise Hills, a school for young ladies located in a remote island in the middle of the ocean. Waking up in Paradise not knowing how she arrived there, she soon meets other students: Amarna, a pop-star who was sent after she decided to sing her own songs against the will of the company that controls her records. Chloe, a plus-sized young lady those parents want to turn thin and compliant. And Yu, a Lower who was sent by her aunt and uncle after refusing to inherit her family business. Uma then meets the eccentric Duchess, Paradise Hills' headmaster. She tries to convince Uma to marry up, just as her mother wants her to. Uma soon suspects a hidden purpose behind all the facility's luxuries. Its elegant staging and the daily sessions of make-up, hairdressing, good manners and therapy are not working on any of her classmates, either. While Amarna and Uma concoct a plan to escape; the latter becomes shocked when Markus appears as part of the Paradise Hills' staff. Amarna, who had started to feel attracted to Uma, feels bitter about this. Finally, alerted by Amarna about their dinners being laced with a sleep-inducing substance, Uma manages to investigate Paradise Hills at night. Discovering the bone-chilling truth: the island is a giant control room to analyze the students' behavior and appearance, in order to be replicated by Lower women, hired to replace the Uppers after the original women are killed. With time running against her, Uma and the rest of her girl gang must find a way to survive before they are up next.

Potem ko so pred mnogimi leti bogovi dobili bitko proti Titanom, Zemlji grozi nova nevarnost.

Epska zgodba o maščevanju in usodi. Oblasti željni kralj Hiperion grozi z uničenjem vsega človeštva v svojem norem iskanju najmočnejšega orožja – legendarnega epirskega loka, ki daje moč, da vojno povzročiš tako na nebu kot na Zemlji.
immortals_2011.opis_omdb: Eons after the Gods won their mythic struggle against the Titans, a new evil threatens the land. Mad with power, King Hyperion (Mickey Rourke) has declared war against humanity. Amassing a bloodthirsty army of soldiers disfigured by his own hand, Hyperion has scorched Greece in search of the legendary Epirus Bow, a weapon of unimaginable power forged in the heavens by Ares (Daniel Sharman). Only he who possesses this bow can unleash the Titans, who have been imprisoned deep within the walls of Mount Tartaros since the dawn of time and thirst for revenge. In the King's hands, the bow would rain destruction upon mankind and annihilate the Gods. But ancient law dictates the Gods must not intervene in man's conflict. They remain powerless to stop Hyperion, until a peasant named Theseus (Henry Cavill) comes forth as their only hope. Secretly chosen by Zeus (Luke Evans), Theseus must save his people from Hyperion and his hordes. Rallying a band of fellow outsiders, including visionary Priestess Phaedra (Freida Pinto) and cunning slave Stavros (Stephen Dorff), one hero will lead the uprising, or watch his homeland fall into ruin and his Gods vanish into legend.

Akademski raziskovalec vodi skupino ljudi v boju proti apokaliptičnim dogodkom, ki jih je napovedal starodavni majevski koledar.

Ko se svet začne uničevati, se človeštvo bori za preživetje. Jackson Curtis in njegova družina se trudijo ubežati udarcem meteoritov, potresom ter drugim naravnim nesrečam, ki se ena za drugo zgrinjajo nad Zemljo.
2012_2009.opis_omdb: Dr. Adrian Helmsley, part of a worldwide geophysical team investigating the effect on the earth of radiation from unprecedented solar storms, learns that the earth's core is heating up. mrs. henderson presents_2005.opis_neo:
Zgodba o resničnem londonskem gledališču, ki ga tik pred drugo svetovno vojno odpre ovdovela gospa Henderson.

London leta 1937. Ga. Laura Henderson (Judi Dench), premožna ženska iz dobre družine, je pred kratkim pokopala ljubljenega moža. Zdaj ji je dolgčas. Pri 69-ih je preveč energična in vitalna, da bi se prepustila mirnemu življenju vdove. Prijateljica lady Conway ji predlaga, naj si omisli hobi. Morda bi zbirala diamante ali se ukvarjala z dobrodelnostjo. Toda na ogorčenje svojih prijateljic se Laura odloči kupiti gledališče Windmill v središču Soha. O upravljanju gledališča ne ve ničesar, zato najame Viviana Van Damma (Bob Hoskins). Ga. Henderson osupne tudi poklicnega zabaviščnika, saj je nesramna, provokativna in čudaška. Ter zelo neolikana.
mrs. henderson presents_2005.opis_omdb: Recently widowed well-to-do Mrs. Laura Henderson (Dame Judi Dench) is at a bit of a loose end in inter-war London. On a whim, she buys the derelict Windmill theatre in the West End and persuades impresario Vivian Van Damm (Bob Hoskins) to run it, despite the fact the two don't seem to get along at all. Although their idea of a non-stop revue is at first a success, other theatres copy it and disaster looms. Laura suggests they put nudes in the show, but Van Damm points out that the Lord Chamberlain, Lord Rowland Baring, 2nd Earl of Cromer (Christopher Guest), who licenses live shows in Britain, is likely to have something to say about this. Luckily, Mrs. Henderson is friends with him.

the last exorcism part ii_2013.opis_neo:
Ko Nell Sweetzer poskuša zgraditi novo življenje po vseh dogodkih, se zlobna sila, ki jo je nekoč obsedla, vrne s še bolj grozljivim načrtom.

Nell Sweetzer si skuša ustvariti novo življenje po dogodkih iz prvega filma. Nahaja se na varnem v New Orleansu, kjer se sooča z izgubo spomina. Spominja se le tega, da je edina preživela v družini in da je njeno življenje popolnoma uničeno. After medical and psychological treatment, she is sent to the Deveraux transition house in New Orleans managed by Frank Merle, who helps her to start a new life. She finds a job as a hotel housekeeper, befriends her new roommates, and develops a crush on her coworker, Chris. Soon, Nell comes to realize that she is haunted by people from her cult... and by the same evil force that once possessed her. Resnična zgodba o Tami Oldham in njenem zaročencu Richardu Sharpu, ki sta se odpravila na potovanje prek oceana, nesluteč, da ju bo zajel najmočnejši orkan v zgodovini. adrift_2018.opis_omdb: Starring Shailene Woodley and Sam Claflin, Adrift is based on the inspiring true story of two free spirits whose chance encounter leads them first to love, and then to the adventure of a lifetime. As the two avid sailors set out on a journey across the ocean, Tami Oldham (Woodley) and Richard Sharp (Claflin) couldn't anticipate they would be sailing directly into one of the most catastrophic hurricanes in recorded history. In the aftermath of the storm, Tami awakens to find Richard badly injured and their boat in ruins. With no hope for rescue, Tami must find the strength and determination to save herself and the only man she has ever loved. Adrift is the unforgettable story about the resilience of the human spirit and the transcendent power of love.

Stonebanks, who eluded death once before, now is making it his mission to end The Expendables -- but Barney has other plans. the machinist_2004.opis_neo:
El Maquinista že eno leto ne more spati, zato začne dvomiti v svojo prisebnost.

Trevor Reznik je človek, ki ne ve, če sploh še obstaja ali ne. Spal ni že več kot leto dni in tako je že koščen, da dobesedno izginja. Ve da pred nekom beži, a ne more dojeti pred kom. Prepričan je, da je žrtev zlobne zarote, zato ne verjame nikomur več. Edina svetla točka v njegovem življenju je prostitutka, ki je zaljubljena vanj. Ko najde v stanovanju skrivnostna sporočila in ga začne preganjati skrivnostni kolega, ki ga vidi le on, se Trevor odpravi poiskati resnico.
the machinist_2004.opis_omdb: Trevor Reznik is a machinist in a factory. An extreme case of insomnia has led to him not sleeping in a year, and his body withering away to almost nothing. He has an obsessive compulsion to write himself reminder notes and keep track of his dwindling weight, both scribbled on yellow stickies in his apartment. The only person he lets into his life in an emotional sense is Stevie, a prostitute, although he has an infatuation with Maria, a single mother waitress working in an airport diner. His co-workers don't associate with and mistrust him because of not knowing what is going on in his life that has led to his emaciated physical appearance. A workplace incident further alienates him with his coworkers, and in conjunction with some unfamiliar pieces of paper he finds in his apartment, Trevor believes that someone or some people - probably one or some of his coworkers - are out to get him, using a phantom employee named Ivan as their front. As Trevor goes on a search for evidence as to Ivan's schemes and whereabouts, Trevor may come to a true understanding of what has caused his insomnia.

burnt_2015.opis_neo:
Uspešen kuhar z dvema Michelinovima zvezdicama, slabimi razvadami in še slabšim slovesom, želi doseči še tretjo zvezdico, ki se mu nenehno izmika.

Kuharski mojster Adam Jones je imel vse, a je vse tudi izgubil. Uspešen kuhar z dvema Michelinovima zvezdicama, slabimi razvadami in še slabšim slovesom, želi vedno vse narediti po svoje. Da bi dobil še tretjo Michelinovo zvezdico, ki se mu nenehno izmika, mora marsikaj spremeniti in na svojo stran pridobiti najboljše v poslu.
burnt_2015.opis_omdb: Chef Adam Jones (Bradley Cooper) had it all - and lost it. A two-star Michelin rockstar with the bad habits to match, the former enfant terrible of the Paris restaurant scene did everything different every time out, and only ever cared about the thrill of creating explosions of taste. To land his own kitchen and that third elusive Michelin star though, he'll need the best of the best on his side, including the beautiful Helene (Sienna Miller).
burnt_2015.opis_sl_tmdb: Kuharski mojster Adam Jones je imel vse – in je tudi vse izgubil. Uspešen in vsesplošno poznan kuhar z dvema Michelinovima zvezdicama, slabimi navadami in ugledom razvpite »kuharske dive« se iz Pariza preseli v London, da bi izkoristil novo priložnost, ponovno pridobil ugled ter vzpostavil novo kuhinjo s tremi Michelinovimi zvezdicami.
burnt_2015.opis_en_tmdb: Adam Jones is a Chef who destroyed his career with drugs and diva behavior. He cleans up and returns to London, determined to redeem himself by spearheading a top restaurant that can gain three Michelin stars.
